source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A fairly brief, self-limited viral upper respiratory infection that would not typically produce this particular pattern of symptoms","B":"Bronchiectasis, a condition involving permanent, abnormal widening of the airways, predisposing to chronic infection and mucus accumulation","C":"An improvement in the client's overall airway function reflected by this particular pattern of chronic symptoms","D":"A fairly ordinary, expected finding that would not typically call for any further clinical evaluation or workup"}}
source_row.rationale: Chronic, daily production of large amounts of purulent sputum with recurrent respiratory infections is classic for bronchiectasis, a condition involving permanent, abnormal widening of the airways that impairs normal mucus clearance, predisposing to chronic infection and ongoing symptoms.
source_row.source_name: American Thoracic Society — Bronchiectasis Clinical Features
